articles.title: How to Create Flashcard Sets with AI
articles.summary: Generate high-quality flashcard sets in seconds using PDFs, notes, or chapter topics.

action.label: Try This in Bilkeys: Upload & Build Set

steps.title: Upload Study Material
steps.description: Choose a PDF textbook, lecture notes, or paste document text into the source parser.

platformText.web: Click 'Upload Book' in Library or drag your PDF/DOCX into the upload area.
platformText.mobile: Tap the Library tab, then tap the '+' button to select your document.

steps.tip: Supported formats: PDF, DOCX, PPTX up to 10MB.

steps.title: Select Specific Chapters
steps.description: Keep your study set focused by selecting only the target chapters or sections you need.

platformText.web: Check the boxes next to the desired chapters on the Book Details page before generating.
platformText.mobile: Tap chapter chips to toggle selection on or off in the Book view.

steps.title: AI Generation & Instant Study
steps.description: Bilkeys AI extracts key terms, definitions, and quiz scenarios in seconds.

platformText.web: Click 'Generate Flashcards' to launch your new study set.

sections.heading: Creating a Set from Uploaded PDF or Notes
sections.body: Navigate to the Library page and upload a PDF textbook or document (.pdf, .docx, .pptx). Bilkeys's AI automatically parses chapter structure and generates key term-definition pairs.

sections.heading: Chapter-Specific AI Generation
sections.body: Select specific chapters or sections to keep your study sets targeted. AI generation uses your available AI credits based on your subscription tier.

articles.title: Understanding Daily Review & Smart Spaced Repetition
articles.summary: Learn how automated memory scheduling calculates optimal review dates to maximize retention.

action.label: Try This in Bilkeys: Start Daily Review

sections.heading: How Spaced Repetition Works
sections.body: Every card in Bilkeys tracks an Ease Factor and Interval. When you rate your recall performance (1 to 5), our smart algorithm computes when you should next review the card to lock it into long-term memory.

sections.heading: Daily Review Queue
sections.body: Your Daily Review queue automatically gathers all flashcards due on or before today. Completing your Daily Review session once per day earns +30 XP!

articles.title: Server-Validated XP Rules & Scoring
articles.summary: Complete breakdown of all XP activities, server-side validation, and leaderboard integrity.

action.label: Try This in Bilkeys: View Leaderboard & Earn XP

sections.heading: XP Reward Breakdown
sections.body:
All XP is processed and recorded by the server XP ledger:
- Quiz Completion: +20 XP
- Correct Quiz Answer: +2 XP per verified correct answer
- Daily Review Completion: +30 XP (once per UTC day)
- Card Mastery: +10 XP (awarded once per card when mastered)
- 3-Day Streak: +30 XP
- 7-Day Streak: +75 XP
- 30-Day Streak: +250 XP

sections.heading: Score Integrity & Security
sections.body: Quiz scores and completion totals are validated against server flashcard set records. Manipulated client score submissions are automatically rejected and corrected.

articles.title: Global vs Friends & Groups Leaderboard & Weekly Cycle
articles.summary: How rankings work across Weekly (Mon 00:00 UTC) and All-Time views.

action.label: Try This in Bilkeys: Check Your Rank

sections.heading: Weekly vs All-Time Periods
sections.body: The Weekly Leaderboard resets every Monday at 00:00 UTC, providing a fresh competitive cycle every week. The All-Time view reflects total cumulative XP.

sections.heading: Global Top 25 & Around You View
sections.body: Global scope displays the Top 25 learners across Bilkeys. If you are outside the Top 25, the 'Around You' card shows your exact rank and competitors directly above and below you.

sections.heading: Friends & Groups Scope
sections.body: Switch to Friends & Groups scope to filter rankings down to your active study group members and connected peers.

sections.heading: Strict Overtake Calculation
sections.body: Your standing card indicates the exact XP required to strictly overtake the learner immediately above you, accounting for tie-breaker rules.

steps.title: Send a 1v1 Quiz Challenge
steps.description: Pick a study set and invite a peer or group member to compete.

platformText.web: Click 'New Challenge' on the Challenges page, select a flashcard set, and choose an opponent.
platformText.mobile: Tap the '+' button in the Challenges tab, select a set, and send an invite.

steps.title: View Live Challenge Scorecards
steps.description: Track head-to-head quiz scores and share automated scorecard badges.

platformText.web: Check your pending and completed matches on the Challenges page.
platformText.mobile: Review challenge cards directly in your Challenges tab feed.

sections.heading: Study Groups
sections.body: Create or join study groups to share set materials and compete on the Friends & Groups leaderboard scope.

sections.heading: Challenge Leaderboard vs Normal Leaderboard
sections.body: The Challenge Leaderboard tracks head-to-head quiz challenges and challenge scorecards separately from the XP-based Normal Leaderboard.
